question: In a certain code language, PEN is written as 16514. How will INK be written as in that language?

The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The letters are coded with their positional values.**

**PEN is written as 16514,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29b8f6fbbb04eb00a6e5a07525328ef376bb22f3a9e85a336d802a4d26f3f01d.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b5c9fab42347e8196d453e9c8d2116e27a571c26c82677ab35fe5c436f33ad4.png]
